officialEvidence.observation: ANCFCC is the national land registry/cadastre/cartography authority and describes maintaining the national cadastre and providing digital or analogue cadastral products. This establishes cadastral registry existence, not a public vector feed.
officialEvidence.coverage: National; city-specific polygon feed not stated

officialEvidence.observation: Arabic product page describes parcel plans and repérage maps (urban map scales 1:2,000 or 1:1,000); these are products/documents, not an identified open API.
Online plan-cadastral request form asks for personal identity/contact and land-title identifiers, CAPTCHA, SMS verification and payment. No bypass or record-level query was attempted.
officialEvidence.coverage: Request by known title; not city-wide open geometry

officialEvidence.observation: AUC's official geoportal entry currently presents account sign-in, including emailed security code; no anonymous parcel layer endpoint was exposed on the page.
officialEvidence.coverage: AUC planning-area portal; public parcel access unverified

officialEvidence.observation: Official Open Data page loaded, but its public content contains no dataset or download links. It does not establish parcel geometry publication.
Official municipal Casa Maps page describes an Esri-powered map focused on points of interest and city districts. Page scripts do not advertise cadastral parcel polygons or a public feature service.
officialEvidence.coverage: Citywide points of interest and districts

officialEvidence.observation: Official office directory lists the CASA ANFA external cadastre/conservation office in Casablanca, supporting local registry presence.
officialEvidence.coverage: Casablanca office; no open geometry endpoint

candidateServiceAudit.ownerScope: Moroccan Eaux et Forêts public ArcGIS host; forestry inventory, not ANCFCC
candidateServiceAudit.nativeCrs: Lambert Conformal Conic, Merchich datum; meters; central meridian -5.4, standard parallels 31.7239256667 and 34.8664576667
candidateServiceAudit.semantics: The `foret`, `canton`, `groupe`, `dpanef`, `dranef`, `ccdrf` fields and Bab Azehar layer name identify forest-management parcels/compartments, not urban cadastral parcels. Its published extent excludes the WUP Casablanca coordinate.

boundedQuery.queryScope: 500 m radius around saved WUP point; return at most 5 geometries; only geometry and source parcel codes/management fields requested
boundedQuery.observation: Empty FeatureCollection; no target geometry, parcel code or ownership data returned. One request used a source-specific TLS verification exception because the host certificate chain was not trusted by the local runtime.

candidateServiceAudit.assessment: Preserved as a public forest-compartment lead only; it is not qualifying cadastral evidence for urban Casablanca.

additionalCatalog.observation: Supplementary ArcGIS Online search for a Casablanca parcel/cadastre Feature Service returned no candidate.

requestOutcomes.observation: Returned ANCFCC maintenance page. The web-indexed form currently indicates title/identity fields, CAPTCHA, SMS verification and payment; no request was submitted.
Returned ANCFCC maintenance page; official page content was independently indexed and accessible through search.
Public municipal map page loaded; only district/POI search and Esri map are described.

Page loaded without public dataset listings or vector download links.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Casablanca cadastral records exist under the national ANCFCC mandate and local office; no anonymous city-wide polygon scope verified.
coverageAssessment.registryExistenceScope: National official cadastre plus named Casablanca external office/product catalogue; no public target parcel geometry verified.

qualityAssessment.geometryQuality: no target urban parcel geometry retrieved
qualityAssessment.identityReadiness: not ready; title plan service is request-based and the only public feature-layer candidate is a forest inventory layer outside the target bbox

blocker: ANCFCC exposes products and a title-specific request workflow rather than an anonymous city-wide geometry endpoint; the AUC geoportal requires account/security-code access, its Open Data page lists no vector dataset, and Casa Maps is a city-district/POI map. The public Eaux et Forêts parcel layer is forest inventory outside the target point.
remainingUncertainty: ANCFCC or the AUC may provide a geometry-only extract on request; gated authenticated data were not accessed. The negative search results do not prove no open service exists.
nextStep: Ask ANCFCC/AUC for an anonymous WFS, public parcel layer, or bounded geometry-only extract around the WUP point; validate its CRS, parcel semantics, coverage, native IDs or source-scoped geometry hashes before integration.
identityPolicy: High-quality public geometry can use source-scoped versioned geometry references if native parcel IDs are absent; do not present them as cadastral registry numbers.
